question_text: Employee reports being paid at a reduced regime one month too early.

resolution.summary: A reduced regime was applied one month before the start date in the signed amendment. The HR tool entry was initially treated as the leading source and the payslip was considered correct. After a complaint, the signed amendment showed the later start date and a retro correction was processed.

outcome.note: Initial decision followed the informal Teams advice by the then-consultant (Tom Wouters) that the HR tool is always leading. The employee escalated; the case was reopened and corrected about two months later via retro correction.
